description: The empty document is valid everywhere. The canonical empty state is an empty `Y.XmlFragment`, exactly as y-prosemirror stores it; the empty paragraph exists only in an editor's view (see collaboration/README.md, Empty fragment). Opening, projecting or rendering an empty document writes nothing. Each case is a relaymark-core job by name, as the Rust engine, the Elixir adapter and the Swift package call it.

cases.name: an empty document is an empty fragment
an empty fragment is the empty document
the empty document normalizes to itself
the empty document projects an empty body and empty html
